Package game.gameObjects

Class Cell

java.lang.Object
game.gameObjects.Cell
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Cell>
Direct Known Subclasses:
MovingCell
public class Cell extends Object implements Comparable<Cell>, Serializable
This class represents cell in game with value and color that will be used in board in game.
Author:
Maksym Kulynych

      This method paints the cell with its color and value to the game panel.
      Parameters:
      g2d - Graphics2D object used for painting
      x - x coordinate of the cell on the board
      y - y coordinate of the cell on the board
      cellSize - size of the cell that will be painted
      roundFactor - factor for rounding corners of the cell
